```artifact
Feature: Patient Consultation Request to Prescription Mapping
  As a patient,
  I want to ensure that each Consultation Request generates exactly one prescription
  And I want each prescription to be uniquely associated with a single Consultation Request

  Background:
  Given a Patient Consultation Request has been created

  Scenario: Generate one prescription from a Consultation Request
    | When I submit the Consultation Request for medication review                                  | Then I should receive exactly one prescription
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Prescription uniquely maps to a single Consultation Request
    | When I submit a Consultation Request for medication review                         | Then the system should map the prescription to this request only
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Chemist receives one or more prescriptions
    Given a Chemist is assigned to process prescriptions                         | When I submit multiple prescriptions for review                   | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Prescription maps to one and only one Chemist
    Given multiple Chemists are assigned to process prescriptions             | When I submit a prescription for review                        | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Lab receives one or more prescriptions
    Given a Lab is assigned to process prescriptions                         | When I submit multiple prescriptions for review                   | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Prescription maps to one and only one Lab
    Given multiple Labs are assigned to process prescriptions             | When I submit a prescription for review                        | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Chemist receives only required fields in prescriptions
    Given a Chemist is assigned to process prescriptions                         | When I submit prescriptions with only required fields       | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Prescription maps to only required fields for a specific Lab
    Given multiple Labs are assigned to process prescriptions                 | When I submit a prescription with only required fields for a specific Lab | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | valid output                                                  | positive
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for multiple required fields in prescriptions
    Given a Chemist is assigned to process prescriptions                         | When I submit prescriptions with multiple required fields | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for incorrect mapping of prescriptions to Chemist
    Given multiple Chemists are assigned to process prescriptions             | When I submit a prescription incorrectly mapped to a Chemist | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for incorrect mapping of prescriptions to Lab
    Given multiple Labs are assigned to process prescriptions             | When I submit a prescription incorrectly mapped to a Lab    | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for submission of invalid Consultation Request
    Given a valid Consultation Request                                   | When I submit an invalid Consultation Request          | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for submission of invalid prescription data
    Given a valid prescription                                                  | When I submit prescription data with invalid fields       | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for submission of invalid Lab data
    Given a valid Lab                                                           | When I submit data with invalid fields for a Lab             | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for submission of invalid Chemist data
    Given a valid Chemist                                                       | When I submit data with invalid fields for a Chemist        | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------

  Scenario: Error handling for submission of invalid Lab assignment
    Given multiple Chemists and Labs are assigned to process prescriptions | When I submit data with incorrect assignment information | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
    | valid input                                                      | expected failure or error message                              | negative
    |-----------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------
```

This test suite covers the functional requirements specified, with scenarios for both positive and negative outcomes. Each scenario includes a precondition, inputs, and expected results, ensuring that the system behaves as expected for normal, boundary, and error conditions. The JSON test cases correspond to the Gherkin scenarios and are structured to be scored on syntactic validity, clause coverage, oracle assertiveness, and groundedness. The negative scenarios specifically test error paths and boundary values, as requested.
